name: 四邊留邊的影片卡片＋置中大標題，固定後被下一段蓋過
desc: 四邊留邊、四角圓角的卡片內放滿版影片，大標題與副標置中；捲動時主視覺固定不動，下一個區塊捲上來把它蓋住。
prompt: 主視覺是卡片，上、下、左、右四邊都留邊，四邊留邊相同；卡片上緣和主視覺頂端之間也留同樣的邊，卡片不貼頂；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角。卡片內背景為滿版影片。大標題（可多行）水平置中，放在卡片垂直中央略偏上的位置，約佔畫面寬的六成，完整落在頁面內容寬度內，不超出畫面邊緣；標題下方可放副標，置中對齊，明顯小於大標題，沒有內容時省略，標題位置不變。捲動時整個主視覺固定不動，下一個區塊從下方捲上來，逐漸蓋過主視覺；約捲動 1 個畫面高度後主視覺被完全蓋住，固定結束。
mobile: 卡片仍四邊留邊且四邊留邊相同（上緣同樣不貼頂）、四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角，留邊較窄；仍撐滿一個畫面，高度要避免網址列伸縮造成跳動。背景影片改為直式裁切。大標題仍水平置中，寬度改為接近卡片寬，可斷成多行，副標仍在下方置中。資訊條從右下角移到卡片底部整列。固定後被下一個區塊蓋過的效果保留，同樣約 1 個畫面高度。

en.name: Inset video card with centered headline, pinned and covered by the next section
en.desc: A card with margins on all four sides and all four corners rounded holds a full-bleed video, with a centered headline and subheading; on scroll the hero stays pinned while the next section scrolls up over it.
en.prompt: The hero is a card with equal margins on all four sides (top, bottom, left and right); the top edge of the card also keeps the same margin from the top of the hero, so the card does not touch the top; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right) are rounded. Inside the card the background is a full-bleed video. A headline (may wrap to multiple lines) is horizontally centered, placed slightly above the vertical center of the card, taking about sixty percent of the viewport width and staying fully within the page content width without overflowing the viewport edges. Optionally place a subheading below the headline, center-aligned and clearly smaller than the headline; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the headline. On scroll the whole hero is pinned in place while the next section scrolls up from below and gradually covers it; after about 1 viewport height of scrolling the hero is fully covered and the pin ends.
en.mobile: The card keeps equal margins on all four sides (its top edge still does not touch the top), with all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right) rounded, with narrower margins; it still fills one viewport, avoiding height jumps caused by the mobile address bar resizing. The background video is cropped to portrait. The headline stays horizontally centered, its width grows to nearly the card width and it may break onto multiple lines, with the subheading still centered below it. The info bar moves from the bottom-right corner to a full-width row along the bottom of the card. The pinned-and-covered-by-the-next-section effect is kept, again over about 1 viewport height.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺右下角放一條橫向資訊條：左側一個小標籤，接一條直向分隔線和一段短文字，最右側是一個圓形的箭頭圖示按鈕；文字過長時截斷。
accessories.mobile: 資訊條在手機版移到主視覺底部整列，橫跨卡片寬，文字過長時截斷。

en.prompt: Place a horizontal info bar in the bottom-right corner of the hero: a small label on the left, followed by a vertical divider and a short line of text, with a circular arrow icon button at the far right; overly long text is truncated.
en.mobile: On mobile the info bar moves to a full-width row along the bottom of the hero, spanning the card width, with overly long text truncated.
